messages.subject: Inla spatial varying coefficients are not exploring (oversmoothing?)
parts:
Hello INLA Group,

I think while I run a code as below, the coefficient for spatial varying coefficients are not growing. They are relatively concentrated in one place (added one ss). Is it possible to say where can it go wrong?

a) I have approximately 10 hyperparameters. So it is slow. For some of the I am giving a prefixed value. I am attaching an output image for the output hyperparameters. Should I trust the mean? The SD is also high for some cases.

b) Another possibility is that there is not any significant spatial variation after including the covariates.

c) I played with a couple of kernels. Now I am using besag. Is it somehow over-smoothing? The iid kernel made all the coefficients towards 0. Besag and bym did not differ significantly.

Thank you for you help!

Alokesh
